source_trace.title: Cheerios maker General Mills stock tumbles after sales disappoint

impact_scope_evidence.quote: The company's stock, which has a market value of $29.6 billion, fell by 8% during morning trading.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The decline in General Mills' stock is indicative of broader industry trends, as the company's performance is tied to the consumer staples sector, which includes food and beverage companies.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: Net sales for General Mills' North American retail segment, which accounts for more than half of the company's revenue, fell 2% during its fiscal-fourth quarter ended May 26.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The decline in sales within the North American retail segment, which is a significant part of the company's revenue, reflects a broader industry trend in the food and beverage sector.

impact_scope_evidence.quote: The Minneapolis-based food giant has been trying to adapt to changing consumer tastes as its sales growth has slowed.
impact_scope_evidence.rationale: The company's struggle with slowing sales growth is a common challenge within the food and beverage industry, indicating an industry-wide impact.

scope_evidence.evidence_quote: The company did top Wall Street's estimates on earnings.
scope_evidence.rationale: The stock price movement and earnings performance are part of the broader US equity market, reflecting investor sentiment and market conditions.
